Welcome to mone (“we”, “our”, or “us”). mone provides autonomous quantitative trading and analytics infrastructure connecting Google WeatherNext ensemble forecasts with prediction markets (including Kalshi and Polymarket) under a non-custodial Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) architecture.

We adhere strictly to data minimization principles. We only collect the minimal information necessary to deliver our services, authenticate accounts, and prevent free trial abuse:

  • Google Account Information (OAuth 2.0): When you sign in with Google, we request access to basic profile credentials via standard OAuth 2.0 scopes (openid, email, profile). ## Creative laws

These apply to every brag video regardless of tone.

**Short.** 15-25 seconds. Not one second more without a reason. This holds whether or not narration is on; narration does not extend the window.

1. **Dead-End Dashboard Button in [`OnboardingModal.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Documents/mone/web/src/components/OnboardingModal.tsx):**
   - The button `"Go to Agent Dashboard"` previously only executed `setShowOnboardingPrompt(false)`.

   - The modal only had a payment/pricing button (`"Explore Plans & Pricing"`) instead of guiding the user to setup their agent or jump into trading.

   - If a user opened the `"Setup Agent"` modal from the hero section and clicked `"Continue with Google"`, both `SetupAgentModal` and `OnboardingModal` remained open simultaneously, stacking dark backdrops on top of each other.

1. **Complete Post-Signin Trial Activation Experience ([`OnboardingModal.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/ADMIN/Documents/mone/web/src/components/OnboardingModal.tsx)):**
   - **Trial Introduction & Entitlements:**
     - Displays the user's avatar, name, and email with the pulsing **"7-Day Free Trial Activated"** badge.
